text:
ashok: deploy-bot flagged preflight prompt-eval for candidate v2026.03.1 — summarizer Rouge-L down ~9% vs prod baseline. Holding canary. @product-ops @maria @jon please advise.
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] preflight-eval: candidate=v2026.03.1 metric=rouge_l delta=-0.089 sample_size=250 status=hold links: https://ci.internal/evals/1769123456
maria: ugh, 9% is pretty large. Is it concentrated on any prompt slices?
ashok: typo — meant @ashok. (sorry)
ashok: @maria quick split: long-doc summaries worst drop (avg -14%), short snippets ~-2%. Theres a spike on instruction-style prompts where it hallucinated extra sections.
jon: do we have diffs for model config? quant profile changed?
ashok: config shows only tokenization tweak (trim_whitespace=true) and a new decoding temp schedule. No quant changes.
kevin: if tokenization changed, that can shift rouge. But hallucinations point to decoding schedule change. Can we rerun with old decoding params fast?
ashok: yes. Kickoff rerun now: `./ci/run_eval --candidate v2026.03.1 --decoding-profile=stable`
qa-bot: rerun queued (job 9876). Estimated finish ~4m.
sarah: tagging product-ops for signoff: if we pin prod to v2026.02.9 and hold candidate, need release note update + customer comms?
product-ops: thanks — what's the recommended action from eng? pin or rollback or tweak?
maria: leaning pin the canary (stop promotion) and iterate on decoding schedule. Rolling back prod feels heavy if only canary impacted. But long-doc regressions could affect paying customers.
jon: agree with pin/hold. Also want a small bisect: run v2026.02.9 parameters on candidate to confirm parameter delta is root cause. If that reproduces, we fix param; otherwise bisect more.
kevin: also check sample weighting in evals. Was the long-doc slice newly added?
ashok: long-doc slice added two weeks ago to broaden coverage. It was in the gate but smaller weight previously. We upped it in this run to catch regressions earlier.
maria: good. That explains sensitivity. Still, product needs to OK canary hold.
product-ops: understood. Ops question: what's customer-impact risk if we keep canary frozen for 12-24h?
sarah: minimal — current canary traffic is ~5% internal-only for feature flags. No public release pushed yet.
jon: timeline: rerun finishes + bisect could take 2-3 hours. If we confirm decoding param, we can roll forward a param change quickly. If not, we'd pin and schedule a hotfix in next patch window.
kevin: if decode schedule is culprit, can we apply a quick hotfix patch to candidate and resume canary without full rollback?
ashok: yes, patching decoding schedule is low-risk and doesn't require model retrain. But we need product signoff to proceed with a param-only push to canary.
product-ops: okay please provide the rerun results and a short risk statement. Ill signoff if risk < medium and rollback not required.
qa-bot: rerun job 9876 completed. Summary: rouge_l delta now -0.01 (within noise) with `decoding-profile=stable`. Long-doc slice delta -0.03. Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/9876
maria: that strongly implicates decoding schedule. Good.
jon: can we run A/B with candidate+stable-decode on a small traffic slice to sanity-check before resuming wider canary?
kevin: yes, canary routing supports a conditional rollout. Allocate 2% for A/B with stable decode and monitor token-cost, latency, hallucination alerts.
ashok: I'll prepare a quick rollout plan: 2% for 30m, monitor eval and prod-alerts; if green, expand to 25% then 100% canary.
product-ops: risk statement: candidate with original decode params reduces rouge regression to within acceptable range; residual risk is hallucination on some long-docs until we adjust training prompts. Recommend: hold promotion, apply decode-params patch to candidate, run 2% A/B for 30m, product to signoff to resume.
sarah: product-ops signoff?
product-ops: +1 signoff for param-only canary patch + A/B plan. Please update release notes: add item "Reverted decoding schedule experiment for summarizer to reduce hallucination risk" and note QA tracking ticket.
maria: creating follow-up ticket: INF-4721 with rollback runbook and hotfix checklist. Will include comms template.
ashok: deploying param patch to canary now. Command: `deploybot promote --target canary --patch decode_profile=stable --dry-run=false`
deploy-bot: [ACTION] started patch promotion job 9980. Watch: https://deploy.internal/jobs/9980
jon: watching. I'll monitor WG alerts.
qa-bot: monitoring hooks set: hallucination_alerts, rouge_trackers, latency_deltas.
kevin: if we see any unexpected perf regressions, we revert decode_profile immediately. 
maria: thx all. After 2% A/B, if green, I'll coordinate release note update and schedule full canary expansion.
product-ops: approved. Keep me posted in this thread. :thumbsup: 
ashok: update: 2% A/B ran 35m — metrics stable, no hallucination uptick. Expanding to 25%.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] expansion job 9981 started.
sarah: also added a short blurb to release notes and pinged CS for preemptive comms to enterprise customers.
maria: ticket INF-4721 updated with postmortem checklist and owners.
jon: close loop: keep canary active for at least 12h of business traffic before full promotion. If any alert, we revert decode_profile.
product-ops: thanks everyone. Marking this thread as product-signed for param patch + staged rollout. :white_check_mark:
